factions.name: House of the Julii
factions.description: Frontier Romans of the north, hardened against the Gauls. The Senate points them at the wild lands beyond the Po.

factions.name: House of the Junii
factions.description: Ambitious southern Romans of the gens Junia, whose gaze falls across the Adriatic to Greece and Macedon.

factions.name: House of the Cornelii
factions.description: Patrician Romans of the gens Cornelia charged with Sicily and the long duel against Carthage.

factions.name: The Senate and People
factions.description: The old authority of Rome itself: issuer of missions, arbiter of standing, and final obstacle to any would-be emperor.

factions.name: Kingdom of Macedon
factions.description: The homeland of Alexander, holding the pike-hedges of the old army and the passes of the Balkans.

factions.name: League of Free Cities
factions.description: A defensive league of proud poleis: Sparta, Athens, Rhodes and their kin, rich in hoplites and harbors.

factions.name: Seleucid Realm
factions.description: The sprawling successor empire of the east — elephants, pikes, and enemies on every border.

factions.name: Thracian Tribes
factions.description: Falx-wielding hill peoples between the Greeks and the steppe, part Hellenized and wholly dangerous.

factions.name: Parthian Kingdom
factions.description: Horse lords of the Iranian plains: swarms of horse archers screening irresistible cataphracts.

factions.name: Kingdom of Armenia
factions.description: A mountain kingdom astride the caravan routes, fielding both eastern horse and Hellenic foot.

factions.name: Kingdom of Pontus
factions.description: An Anatolian power of mixed Greek and Persian blood, with scythed chariots and imperial ambitions.

factions.name: Republic of Carthage
factions.description: The merchant republic of the western Mediterranean: silver, ships, mercenaries, and the Sacred Band.

factions.name: Numidian Kingdoms
factions.description: Desert riders and skirmishers of the African interior, unmatched in raid and evasion.

factions.name: Kingdom of the Nile
factions.description: The wealthiest farmland in the world under dynasts who rule in the old style: temple, chariot, and river. A deliberately archaizing court, part pageant, part power.

factions.name: Gallic Tribes
factions.description: The great confederation of Celtic peoples: numberless warbands, fierce charges, restless chiefs.

factions.name: Germanic Tribes
factions.description: Forest peoples beyond the Rhine — spear hosts, night raids, and berserk fury.

factions.name: British Tribes
factions.description: Chariot-riding islanders behind the mists and the channel, painted for war.

factions.name: Dacian Tribes
factions.description: Carpathian highlanders rich in gold and iron, swinging the two-handed falx.

factions.name: Iberian Tribes
factions.description: Hard peoples of the peninsula, masters of the ambush and the curved falcata.

factions.name: Scythian Hordes
factions.description: Nomads of the endless grass north of the Black Sea; every rider a bowman, every camp a fortress.

factions.name: Independents
factions.description: Free towns, brigand bands, secessionists, and pirates owing allegiance to no crown.
